title: Hate Evil Hold Fast to Good

request.style: English, warm female solo voice, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, soft drums, uplifting and sincere, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Love must be genuine and true
Not a mask put on for view
Hate what is evil in your heart
Hold fast to what is good apart

[Pre-Chorus]
Devoted to one another
Brotherly love is the path
Outdo one another in honor
Let the spirit be fervent and strong

[Chorus]
Hate evil hold fast to good
Let love be genuine and true
Outdo one another in showing honor
Serve the Lord with zeal and fire

[Verse]
Rejoice in hope endure in affliction
Persevere in prayer with patience
Share with the saints in their needs
Pursue hospitality with ease

[Chorus]
Hate evil hold fast to good
Let love be genuine and true
Outdo one another in showing honor
Serve the Lord with zeal and fire

[Bridge]
Fervent in spirit serve the Lord
Let your zeal never grow slack
Joy in hope through every trial
Faithful love is the mark

[Chorus]
Hate evil hold fast to good
Let love be genuine and true
Outdo one another in showing honor
Serve the Lord with zeal and fire

[Outro]
Let love be genuine and true
Hate evil hold fast to good
